text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm at the dance studio with Inari One,
watching
her rehearsal.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hm... I just can't get into it.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Don't be silly! When it's festival time, I'm
all
about goin' big—dancin', haulin' stuff,
and stirrin'
up the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm just not really into shufflin' 'round in
small and
cramped places, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If this was the real thing, I'd be gettin'
all fired up
along with the audience.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But no point grumblin'. Gotta put in the
effort
behind the scenes, too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh? Do ya even got what it takes?
choice_data_list: それなら、俺が盛り上げてみようか？
それなら、私が盛り上げてみようか？

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's me, the one and only great
Inari! ♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wahoo! Wahoo! ♪
choice_data_list: わっしょいわっしょい♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hm?! Wh-whoa, my body's movin' to the
beat
without me even thinkin' about it!
You're good!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
All right, that's the stuff! Keep hypin' me
up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One appears to be fired up and
ready to go.
Now, it's time to kick things
up a notch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:

ready to go.
Now, it's time to kick things
up a notch.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Sounds good! Who're ya bringin'?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Heya! It's me, Bamboo Memory,
reporting for
duty to cheer on Inari!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Go, go! Inari! Fight on! Fight!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
O-oi, Bamboo! Aren't ya missin' the
whole point?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Fight ON! Fight ON! Inari is number
ONE! She's
the best in all JAPAN!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Not gettin' through to her. She's a
burnin' ball
of energy like always.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Meh... I'm gettin' waaay too wrapped up
in the
details. Lemme borrow that vigor
and bust out my
signature dance moves!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Inari One happily dances her
heart out
until she's drenched in sweat!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-ho! You're pretty gutsy! All right,
gimme a
good beat to work with!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I borrow a drum from the storage shed.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's get this show on the road!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! You've got some skills with
those sticks!
My body's movin' to the
beat without me thinkin'
about it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, here we go! ♪ Wahoo, let's
go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Inari One dances up a storm and ends up
being
extremely satisfied with her
rehearsal.
